analyst_assumptions: Independence of household size, plug-in ownership and heating across different survey years; unsupported for adopters.
All synthesized homes use SFH demand anchors even though marginal frequencies describe all households/dwellings.
5plus topcoded to5 persons and uses5-person demand anchor.
Source ambient-heat category mapped to Heatpump as a scenario proxy, not verified universal label.
Demand multiplier uniform0.6-1.6, conditional EV km5000-25000, useful heat8000-30000, price0.32, and installer mixing are analyst choices, not empirical distributions.
Other heating including district heat maps Unknown with heat demand omitted; no invented district-to-gas translation.

heating.mapping: Gas->Gas; oil->Oil; wood->OtherRenewable; ambientgroup->Heatpump is an explicit proxy assumption, since source category is not pure heat pumps; other18%->Unknown because no district-heat schema enum.
heating.meaning: Dwelling heating primary energy: gas56%,oil19%,wood/pellets4%,solar/geothermal/ambient/exhaust heat3%,district15% plus arithmetic remainder3%.

household_size.meaning: Percent of main-residence households by size, final2024;5plus is not exactly5.

interpretation: Source-backed independent marginal scenario over all German households/dwellings in different years. Not a German SFH/PV-adopter joint distribution or a population accuracy estimate.

plug_in_vehicle.meaning: Households possessing electric car or plug-in hybrid; includes privately usable company cars under EVS definition. Not pure BEV, not percent of vehicles, not home-charging share.
plug_in_vehicle.selection: EVS2023 section, not LWR2024(6.3%) or stock-per100households(7.1).
